anomaly_label: Overshooting pressure-control response of vacuum throttle valve (TV1)

evidence.observation: Rapid rise 69→82.8 °C at k=18-19, consistent with vapor front reaching upper section
System pressure dropped from ~555 to ~508-519 mbar at k=19-20
Distillate and reflux flows stepped up (0.21/0.41 → 0.29/0.62) coincident with the front arrival
Steady monotonic reboiler heat-up throughout, plateauing near 107.9 °C at k=19-20

args.missing_evidence: A distillate composition measurement (GC/refractometer) and confirmation that the PY23 pressure step and T711 breakthrough are the intended start of takeoff rather than a pressure-control upset.
